gradient_text: OPTIMIZABLE_GUIDANCE only says to apply frozen definitions conservatively with no ordered decision procedure for Configuration, so it fails to operationalize minimality and relevance. It should direct a two-step filter-then-minimize check: first test if a candidate product mention can plausibly serve as the tail of a directly supported vulnerability-affects fact and reject incidental tools, protocols, services, OS or environment mentions and generic placeholders, then shrink any surviving span to the shortest independently identifiable core by stripping version lists/ranges, feature/component qualifiers, parenthetical expansions, and trailing generic nouns before verifying exact offsets. Without that explicit procedure the model defaults to maximal noun phrases and to any technology-like token, producing overlong boundaries and systematic false positives.
